annotations.title: Bind a Bing Webmaster site to a project

description: Link (or repoint) a project's Bing Webmaster site. `siteUrl` is re-validated against the caller's LIVE site list on every call — fails if the site fell out of the connected account's access since it was last listed via list_bing_sites.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

siteUrl.description: Bing's own site URL string, taken verbatim from list_bing_sites.

name: set_bing_site
